meta.name: task-coordination-strategies
meta.description: Decompose complex tasks, design dependency graphs, and coordinate multi-agent work with proper task descriptions and workload balancing. Use this skill when breaking down work for agent teams, managing task dependencies, or monitoring team progress.

copy.tagline: 拆解复杂任务，协调多个代理高效执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要带领多个 AI 代理一起完成复杂任务
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex tasks and coordinate multiple agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to lead multiple AI agents to finish complex tasks together

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把复杂任务拆成可并行的单元,设计任务依赖关系(blockedBy/blocks),写出含目标、所属文件、接口契约和验收标准的任务描述,并查看各成员工作量、重新分配任务。
howto.when: 当你为 agent 团队拆分工作、设计任务依赖(blockedBy/blocks),或写任务描述、监控团队进度时触发。

say.text: 把这个全栈功能拆成可并行的任务,标出依赖关系
say.note: 会创建任务并建立 blockedBy 关系

say.text: 给这个任务写含目标、所属文件和验收标准的描述
say.note: 按模板生成任务描述各段

say.text: 看看团队谁空闲谁超载,帮我重新分配任务
say.note: 先列任务,再改派并通知成员

howto.what_en: Claude breaks complex work into parallel units, designs dependency graphs (blockedBy/blocks), writes task descriptions with objective, owned files and acceptance criteria, and monitors workload to rebalance tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you split work for agent teams, design task dependencies (blockedBy/blocks), write task descriptions, or monitor team progress.

say_en.text: Break this full-stack feature into parallel tasks and map dependencies
Write this task's description with objective, owned files, acceptance criteria
Check who's idle or overloaded and reassign the team's tasks
